title: Registry for neonates, infants, children, adolescents, and adults with newly diagnosed and/or relapsed neuroblastic tumors (NB Registry 2016)
summary: The NB 2016 Registry collects key data on all newborns, infants, children, adolescents and adults with so-called neuroblastic tumors, i.e. neuroblastoma, ganglioneuroblastoma, and ganglioneuroma. The registry is the frame for the central review of imaging, histology, and molecular diagnostics. It also offers the opportunity for case discussions with reference surgeons and radiotherapists on request of the treating physicians. Further, in the registry biomaterial such as blood and tumor samples are collected and stored with strict data protection regulations.

interventions.name: Patients with neuroblastic tumors are registered at the time of first diagnosis. The treating physicians report key epidemiologic and clinical data to the registry during treatment. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Diagnosis or suspicion of neuroblastic tumor in patients either histologically or cytologically proven neuroblastic tumors such as neuroblastoma, ganglioneuroblastoma, and ganglioneuroma (at diagnosis or at
relapse), also suspected neuroblastoma in newborns and infants (e.g. suprarenal lesions) detected at least during two independent ultrasound investigations, any age, any stage, any MYCN status, written Guardians’ informed consent of parents or legal guardians and / or of the patient’s informed consent if appropriate according to age and status of psycho-intellectual development.
Exclusion criteria:
For this registry, no exclusion criteria are defined. Each patient meeting the inclusion criteria given above may be registered.
